jess: quick sync for Acme POC tomorrow. Need a hosted API key for demo: streaming enabled, IP whitelist 192.0.2.0/24, TTL 6h, tag `sales/acme_demo`, set audit retention 90d. Do not paste token in shared docs.

mike: can do. CLI issuance + metadata. Confirm scopes: generate + stream only?

jess: yes, no embeddings. Also add `revocation_owner:sales` and note `demo=2025-04-01`.

tara: i'll prepare a short rotation playbook: 1) create new token, 2) DM token to SE, 3) revoke old token, 4) verify audit entry. attach to ticket.

security: +1. enforce revoke-on-idle 48h and make sure key secret isn't checked into repos. For external demos recommend one-time token if possible.

ops-bot: SLS-4999 created and queued for token issuance.

mike: issuing now. created token id=tok_01HBetaDemo expires=176778.0000 (6h). IP allowlist applied. audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme/poc/logs?ticket=SLS-4999

mike: example request for SE on call:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_ACME_DEMO_<REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"rw-stream-1\",\"input\":\"Hello demo\"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

jess: DM received. we'll use it only on the live demo and rotate immediately after. tara, please run the checklist and close SLS-4999 after revoke verification.

tara: will do. scheduled reminder for 7h post-issuance to rotate.

mike: noted. closing thread. :rocket:
